meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides SHOUTcast's own cookie bar (#cookieDough), the hero banner, genre list and footer; dim or hide listener and bitrate columns
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, iPhone UA 390x844 in headless Chrome, directory.shoutcast.com home page. Counts are `querySelectorAll` on the rendered DOM saved from that load (scripts then switched off to evaluate): cookie bar `#cookieDough` 1 (the original list had no rule for it, so a new rule was added), hero 1, genre list 1, station rows 50 each with listeners/bitrate/type/genre cells, footer 1. Station list columns are `td.listeners`, `td.bitrate`, `td.encode`, `td.genre`; Play and Download cells are never touched. No ad slots were present (SHOUTcast's own ads are in the player pages, not checked).

NOT verified: genre pages, search results, the station page with the Winamp player, desktop layout (same DOM, wider), original ad and app-banner rules (nothing on this page matches them).
